# v3.15.2 dependency security remediation

Date: 2026-10-05. Branch: `release/ima_op`.

The user required fixing the audit findings before publication. No advisory
exception, target exclusion, or severity downgrade is used.

| Finding | Remediation |
| --- | --- |
| `rustls` 0.23.42, RUSTSEC-2026-0285 | Locked to patched 0.23.45; `rustls-webpki` 0.103.15 |
| Five unmaintained `unic-*` crates | Tauri 2.12.1 / tauri-utils 2.10.1 selects urlpattern 0.6.0, removing them |
| Unmaintained `proc-macro-error` 1.0.4 | Backport upstream syn diagnostics in GTK/GLib macro crates; dependency and attr companion removed |

`rust-version` is now 1.90, matching the updated Tauri minimum. Use the checked-in
Cargo lockfile on both platforms. The vendor patches retain original licensing
and source provenance; see `vendor/README.md`. License checking includes the
local third-party crates. Release branches now run desktop CI and dependency
audits, plus native Linux tests for the backported macro crates.

Local Windows validation:

- Whole-lock `cargo-deny 0.20.2 check advisories`: **0 errors, 0 warnings**.
- Production `npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high`: **0 vulnerabilities**.
- Rust application tests: **187 passed, 5 opt-in tests ignored**.
- Frontend: build passed; **107 tests passed**.
- Macro diagnostic and existing pure unit tests: **9 passed**.
- Application rustfmt and Clippy with `-D warnings`: passed.
- Dependency licenses: **295 npm packages / 541 Rust crates** passed.

The provider/model/Agent business code is unchanged. The Tauri runtime and TLS
libraries have changed, so these checks alone do not establish installed-app
compatibility. A rebuilt Windows installer and real ima regression, remote
platform CI, and a new notarized Mac package are still required. The former
Windows and Mac candidate hashes must not be reused for release.

The user will build the Mac package on another computer after receiving the
fixed source commit. Public deployment and the release tag remain pending until
both replacement packages have passed validation.
